b3_reselection.analytic_note: With tau below every inference latency, a scheduled drift always precedes submission. A lenient publication then has expected reward <= (1-p) - lambda*p, a revocation >= -(1-p)*mu; at lambda=5, p=0.5 revoking dominates for any grounding accuracy.

category_holdout.note: Disjoint frame sets. The VLM is zero-shot, so this compares category difficulty; it does not test generalisation of the VLM.
